description: This file defines the ExternalOAuthProvider class, which manages OAuth provider configurations, access control, and related operations within the SuiteCRM system. It includes methods for retrieving, saving, and permission checking, as well as generating configuration arrays and redirect URIs.

classes.name: ExternalOAuthProvider
classes.description: Represents an OAuth provider with methods for configuration, access control, and URI generation within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: retrieve
methods.description: Retrieves a record by ID, with access check for personal account.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the provider record after access validation.

methods.name: hasAccessToPersonalAccount
methods.description: Checks if the current user has access to a personal account.

methods.name: logPersonalAccountAccessDenied
methods.description: Logs an access denied event for personal account operations.

methods.name: bean_implements
methods.description: Checks if the bean implements a specific interface.

methods.name: ACLAccess
methods.description: Determines access permissions based on user roles and actions.

methods.name: create_new_list_query
methods.description: Creates a list query with access filtering based on user roles.

methods.name: keepWriteOnlyFieldValues
methods.description: Preserves write-only field values during record updates.

methods.name: isAdminOnlyAction
methods.description: Checks if an action is restricted to admin users.

methods.name: isSecurityGroupBasedAction
methods.description: Checks if an action is security group based.

methods.name: isNotAllowedAction
methods.description: Checks if an action is disallowed.

methods.name: getRedirectURI
methods.description: Builds the redirect URI based on site URL and configuration.

methods.name: getConfigArray
methods.description: Returns the OAuth provider configuration array.

methods.name: deserializeMapField
methods.description: Decodes JSON-encoded fields into arrays.

methods.name: getScope
methods.description: Retrieves OAuth scope as a space-separated string.

methods.name: getExtraProviderParams
methods.description: Returns extra provider parameters.

methods.name: getTokenRequestOptions
methods.description: Returns token request options.

methods.name: getRefreshTokenRequestOptions
methods.description: Returns refresh token request options.

methods.name: getAuthorizeUrlOptions
methods.description: Returns authorization URL options.

methods.name: getRefreshTokenRequestGrant
methods.description: Returns the grant type for refresh token requests.

methods.name: getTokenRequestGrant
methods.description: Returns the grant type for token requests.

methods.name: getAccessTokenMapping
methods.description: Returns the mapping key for access tokens.

methods.name: getRefreshTokenMapping
methods.description: Returns the mapping key for refresh tokens.

methods.name: getExpiresInMapping
methods.description: Returns the mapping key for token expiry.

methods.name: getTokenTypeMapping
methods.description: Returns the mapping key for token type.
